info.title: Pretty Charts API
info.description: Pretty Charts renders a chart from inline data and returns it as static SVG (or a complete HTML document) inside a JSON object. Every data mark carries a native <title> tooltip, so nothing needs to be loaded or executed on the client. The renderer is Vega-Lite: send a full Vega-Lite spec in 'spec', or the shorthand form in 'chart' (type, x, y, color, ...). Data must be inline (csv, tsv, json, or values); remote URLs are refused. Every response, including errors, is a JSON object. Callers cannot send request headers through a Pocket gateway, so every input lives in the request body. Output is deterministic: identical requests to any supplier running the same version return identical bytes.

200.description: At least one render worker is ready

get.summary: What this deployment renders: mark types, shorthand types, themes, output formats, and the active limits

post.description: Send inline data plus either a Vega-Lite spec ('spec') or the shorthand form ('chart'). The response carries the rendered SVG in 'html' as the last field. Rejections are 4xx with a JSON error; the limits are reported by GET /v1/capabilities.

shorthand-bar.summary: Bar chart from CSV via the shorthand form

shorthand-scatter.summary: Scatter plot with a color series, custom axis ranges, and chosen tooltip fields

vega-lite-spec.summary: A full Vega-Lite spec (layers, transforms, and every encoding channel are available)

400.description: Bad request: invalid JSON, invalid request shape, invalid or unsupported spec, unknown field, remote data

413.description: Over a limit: body_too_large, too_many_rows, too_many_marks, output_too_large

422.description: The spec is valid but could not be rendered, or the render exceeded its budget

ChartRequest.description: Exactly one of 'spec' or 'chart' is required. 'data' is required with 'chart' and optional with 'spec' (a spec may carry inline data.values instead).

csv.description: CSV text with a header row. Numbers and ISO dates are parsed automatically.

tsv.description: Tab-separated text with a header row.

json.description: A JSON array of row objects, as a string.

parse.description: Optional Vega parse spec for csv/tsv (e.g. {"date": "date:'%d/%m/%Y'"}); default 'auto'.

spec.description: A Vega-Lite v6 spec. Any 'url' anywhere in the spec is refused; use inline data. Set encoding.description to control the tooltip text.

ChartShorthand.description: Compiles to a single-view Vega-Lite spec. Each channel takes a column name or a Vega-Lite field definition object; field types are inferred from the data when omitted. Field objects also accept the sugar keys domain, range, scheme, zero, nice, reverse (folded into scale).

y.description: Column name or field definition; for pie/donut, mapped to theta

color.description: Column name or field definition; for pie/donut, x is mapped here when color is absent

opacity.description: A number sets the mark opacity; an object or column name is an encoding

colors.description: Color scale range (CSS colors). With no color channel, the first entry colors the mark.

colorScheme.description: A Vega color scheme name for the color channel, e.g. 'tableau10', 'viridis'

stack.description: Stacking for the y channel: true, 'zero', 'normalize', 'center', or null

point.description: For line/area: true or a mark definition to draw points

interpolate.description: For line/area: linear, monotone, step, basis, cardinal, ...

tooltip.description: false to disable tooltips, or an array of column names to show in each tooltip (default: the encoded fields)

title.description: Chart title (string or Vega-Lite title object)

mark.description: Extra Vega-Lite mark properties merged into the mark definition

format.description: svg returns the bare <svg> element (inline-able in HTML); html wraps it in a minimal document

tooltips.description: Add a native <title> tooltip to every data mark

theme.description: A vega-themes preset: dark, excel, fivethirtyeight, ggplot2, googlecharts, latimes, powerbi, quartz, urbaninstitute, vox, carbonwhite, carbong10, carbong90, carbong100

seed.description: Seed for random transforms (sample), so output stays deterministic

config.description: A Vega-Lite config object merged over the theme

marks.description: Data-mark items drawn (bars, points, line vertices, slices)

warnings.description: Vega-Lite and Vega warnings, if any

html.description: The SVG element (format svg) or a complete HTML document (format html). Always the last field.

details.description: Code-specific detail: schema errors, the column list, or the limit that was hit
